follow-up time: Until pregnancy or for a period sufficient to assess menstrual cycle length and pelvic pain
exposure: Hysteroscopy combined with transvaginal repair of cesarean section diverticulum (CSD)
outcome: Operative outcomes (operation time, blood loss, duration of hospitalization)
cohort: 183 patients with scar diverticulum after cesarean section
finding: Transvaginal repair of CSD with hysteroscopy was effective in improving symptoms, increasing residual myometrial thickness, and achieving a high pregnancy rate (66.95%) without uterine rupture.
